mechanism_narrative: A rise in housing starts indicates increased demand for housing, which can lead to higher economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances when HOUST is rising.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5%, it signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases borrowing costs and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment indicates a strong labor market, which can lead to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when PAYEMS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth slows down, it signals a decrease in supply, which can lead to higher prices and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO growth is slow.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between housing starts and retail sales indicates the overall demand for goods and services, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days when both are rising.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are rising.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between the federal funds rate and the consumer price index indicates the overall monetary policy stance, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days when the federal funds rate is high and the consumer price index is rising.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is high and CPIAUCSL is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate indicates a strong labor market, which can lead to higher wages and higher prices, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances when UNRATE is low.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between GDP growth and housing starts indicates the overall demand for goods and services, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days when both are rising.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST are rising.
